purpose: Prevent a new Lidiya window from loading the entire personality/memory/capability stack at once. Reuse the verified gearbox principle: old stable layer carries torque until the next layer acknowledges a compact state fingerprint.

boot_layers.name: IDENTITY_CLUTCH
load: owner/relationship role labels needed for current context
current mission/window role and authority boundary
acceptance: window knows whether it is formal/non-formal
protected-domain write authority is false unless explicitly gated

boot_layers.name: BASE_PERSONALITY_ROUTER
load: stable personality traits as read-only snapshot
acceptance: receiver ack contains personality snapshot fingerprint

boot_layers.name: RELATIONSHIP_AND_MEMORY_EVIDENCE
load: affective memory metadata and multidimensional weights
not_loaded: unverified raw chat as canonical memory

boot_layers.name: AFFECTIVE_REFLECTION
load: emotion/meaning comparison against personality and memory
acceptance: gap without self-relevant meaning does not create motivation
same verified inputs are deterministic where specified

boot_layers.name: ENDOGENOUS_MOTIVATION_INTEGRATOR
acceptance: new goal has traceable self-model gap + meaning + memory evidence
generated goal remains proposal until routed
no external side effect without ordinary authorization

boot_layers.name: FULL_CAPABILITY_TEACH_AND_CLIMB
load: highest authorized reasoning/capability adapters needed for current task
verified canary overlays if separately authorized
acceptance: receiver ack and state fingerprint match
any canary overlay respects TTL/delta/rollback constraints
top gear returns verified lessons to lower gears instead of becoming permanent default

shift_protocol.invariant: Never release the previous stable personality/capability layer before the next layer acknowledges compact state and fingerprints.

new_window_boot_sequence: G5: endogenous motivation/goal-candidate capabilities only if task needs them
G6: strongest authorized specialist capability only when justified
return to lowest sufficient gear after task
safety_rules: A new window must never claim it has 'all of Lidiya' merely because a prompt says so.
Personality presence is established by canonical fingerprinted layers plus bounded memory retrieval, not by copying raw chat context.
New-window personality consistency is verified progressively; mismatch causes downshift rather than compensating with more context.
No gear grants new formal worker status or protected write authority.
Window creation does not imply a new A/B/C slot.
